newsitem.title: USA: Penske hires top ITT Automotive executive.
newsitem.headline: Penske hires top ITT Automotive executive.

text.p: Penske Corp said Tuesday it hired ITT Automotive President Timothy Leuliette as Penske's new president and chief operating officer.

Leuliette, who also was previously a senior vice president of ITT Industries Inc, ITT Automotive's parent company, will initially focus his efforts on Penske's industrial businesses, which include Detroit Diesel Corp AG Kuhnle, Kopp & Kausch and Diesel Technology Co.
Leuliette, who was named a Penske Corp director and a member of its executive committee, also will spearhead the company's global expansion activities.
Leuliette, 46, joined ITT in 1991 and previously served as president and chief executive officer of Siemens Automotive LP, a unit of Siemens AG

Penske, a diversified transportation services company with 1995 revenues exceeding $4 billion, also has interests in several other companies, including race track operator Penske Motorsports Inc, Italian diesel engine maker VM Motori SpA, Penske Truck Leasing, Penske Auto Centers and Penske Automotive Group, a car dealership group.
